description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEngine' which implements the 'GenericEngine' interface. It manages service locations, configuration parameters, and callback mechanisms for service invocation within the Apache OFBiz framework's service engine module.

classes.name: AbstractEngine
classes.description: An abstract class for service engines that handles configuration, location mapping, and callback dispatching within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createLocationMap
methods.description: Loads service locations from configuration and creates an immutable map of location names to their paths.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Determines the actual service implementation location, accounting for aliasing via the location map.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded methods to notify registered callbacks about service events, errors, or results with different contexts.

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Determines whether callbacks should be invoked, defaulting to true.
